runs.text: Transaction is a card-based payment. The smart-card is a system that stores values for transactions on a computer chip located on the card itself. As the card is used for transactions, the amounts are subtracted from a balance on the chip. As the balance approaches zero, the chip can be “reloaded” through a number of methods.
